name: sleeper-mcp
description: Read-only lineup context for Sleeper fantasy football leagues
long_description: Lets Claude read a Sleeper league's rules, your roster and a week's starting lineup so it can help you review them. Read-only: it only calls Sleeper's public read API and never changes a lineup, roster, league or account. Not affiliated with Sleeper.

tools.name: get_lineup_context
tools.description: Returns one league's rules, the user's roster with each player's placement, and the starting lineup for one week.

scope_registry.title: Scope registry
scope_registry.description: Optional JSON file that pins or excludes specific leagues. Leave it empty to serve any league that meets the supported structure.
